summary.titlesTipSummary: How many of the top 10 titles hold the whole keyword, its words in order. Titles that hold only some of the words, or match only without accents, do not count.
summary.ratingsTipSummary: The median rating count of the top 10 apps, a rough measure of how established the top-ranked apps are. Google Play reports no counts, so its average rating shows instead.
summary.keywordInTipSummary: How many of the top 10 hold every word of the keyword in their title, in any order. AsoBeast knows subtitles only for your apps and competitors, from their captured listings. A competitor in the top 10 without the keyword in either is marked Outlier, though it may still hold the keyword in its private keyword field.
